offering_description.value: Provides aerial wildfire management services, including firefighting airtanker operations, aerial ignition and fire intelligence, using its own and leased aircraft. Sells contracted flight availability and services mainly to government wildfire agencies, and to utilities and land managers.

primary_services.value: aerial firefighting; aerial ignition; wildfire mapping and intelligence; aircraft maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2G: US federal and state wildfire and land management agencies; B2B: utilities and private land managers

end_markets.value: wildfire management; government land management; utilities; forestry

revenue_model.value: project or contract: government contracts paid for aircraft availability and flight hours during fire seasons; service fees: aerial firefighting and ignition services billed per mission

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells aerial firefighting services to government agencies and utilities; asset operator: owns and operates a fleet of firefighting aircraft, takes in contract fees and sells flight capacity

geography_served.value: US national: Western US states such as Montana, California and Oregon, with bases across wildfire-prone regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: aerial wildfire management services and aircraft operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts signed directly with government agencies and utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aviation operations need FAA operating certification and aircraft airworthiness approval, aerial ignition is subject to federal and state fire rules
